Name: Sol de Pelican Town News Broadcast - TV channel
Author: aylen13tejas
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds a news channel to the TV called "Sol de Pelican Town" (in honour of my local radio station), in which the Annoying Dog from Undertale tells you whether the Traveling Merchant and/or the Bookseller are in town.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download this mod's zip file, export it, and copy it into your Mods folder.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download [url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/broadcastapi/files/7821953]BroadcastAPI by Astraios911 on CurseForge[/url], export it and copy it into your Mods folder.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Enjoy![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
This is a first version of a Pelican Town news channel I have in mind. So far, it features Undertale's "Annoying Dog" as the news anchor (with Monet's 1890 painting "Effet de printemps à Giverny" as the background), who will notify you on a daily basis on whether the Traveling Merchant and/or the Bookseller are in town. I have more news ideas to add in the future, and please lmk yours too!

The channel's name, "Sol de Pelican Town" (from spanish, Sun of Pelican Town), comes from my local news radio station, Sol de [not doxxing myself today]. 

I should try to make a spanish translation in the near future (I am a native spanish speaker, but I dislike the game's official translation so I play in english).

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
In order to function correctly, this mods requires  [url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/broadcastapi/files/7821953]BroadcastAPI by Astraios911 on CurseForge[/url].
This mod was made with SDV 1.6.x and SMAPI 4.5.2+ in mind.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Shout out to Toby Fox and Jean-Claude Monet I guess.[/size][/color]

[color=#ff00ff][size=3][i]LMK if you have any suggestions or find any bugs![/i][/size][/color]
[color=#ff00ff][size=3][i]Baiiii[/i][/size][/color]
